The '''Karbonni asteroid belt''' was located in the [[Pax system/Legends|Pax system]]. The cargo [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Fool's Gold]]'', loaded with [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]], was lost in the belt until its cargo was recovered by adventurers in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
